content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling design assets such as ebooks, templates, or digital art often requires a reliable payment infrastructure. For many creators, platforms like Gumroad or PayPal are not viable options due to local restrictions or exorbitant fees. By leveraging crypto payments, creators can bypass these limitations entirely, retaining more of their earnings and maintaining full control over their sales processes. This shift to a decentralized financial model not only empowers creators but also expands their market reach globally.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The core architecture for selling digital products with crypto payments consists of several interconnected components. Using solutions like Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and NOWPayments for processing crypto transactions, creators can easily set up an automated system for sales. This setup allows for real-time payment verification and instant product delivery without relying on traditional payment gateways. The seamless integration of these technologies ensures a smooth buying experience for customers while minimizing transaction fees, typically just 0.5% with NOWPayments compared to 10% with platforms like Gumroad.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where mainstream payment processors fail to provide adequate support. Whether you're a graphic designer in Zimbabwe or an educator in Kenya, this system enables you to sell your work without the risk of payment rejection or high fees. The architecture empowers you to maintain ownership of your content and customer data, allowing you to build a sustainable business model that thrives on your terms.
Retain 921 more dollars with lower transaction fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of this digital commerce stack include hosting solutions like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which provide free and secure platforms for your online store. Additionally, backend functionalities can be handled through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, while product data can be stored in Supabase or Google Sheets. File delivery is streamlined through services like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. When integrated with NOWPayments, this architecture creates a cohesive system that automates the sales process while ensuring low-cost transactions.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, select a digital product to sell, then choose your hosting solution. Set up your backend using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle payment logic and order management. Next, integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing, ensuring you configure it to convert prices in real-time. Finally, test your setup to ensure payments are processed smoothly and that customers receive their products instantly. For a comprehensive approach, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which offers all necessary blueprints and templates for a successful deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using crypto payment solutions like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept various cryptocurrencies, reducing transaction costs and avoiding the restrictions imposed by traditional payment platforms. By deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, you gain full control over your sales while ensuring instant delivery of your products.
Empower your sales with full control over your digital assets.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, consider exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This resource provides everything you need to establish a fully functional online store that leverages crypto payments, allowing you to bypass traditional payment gateways efficiently.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept payments for digital products without PayPal?

You can accept payments by integrating crypto payment solutions like NOWPayments, which allows transactions in various cryptocurrencies. This eliminates the need for PayPal or other conventional methods, giving you full control over your sales.
What are the fees associated with selling digital downloads?

Using NOWPayments, the fee is only 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This difference can lead to substantial savings for creators, especially with high sales volumes.
Is it possible to automate product delivery?

Yes, by utilizing backend solutions like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate the delivery of digital products as soon as payment is confirmed, ensuring a seamless customer experience.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept as payment?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT. This flexibility enables you to cater to a broad audience with varying preferences.
Do I need technical skills to set this up?

While some technical knowledge is helpful, the resources provided in the Complete Builder Kit ($197) equip you with all necessary blueprints and templates, making it accessible for anyone willing to learn.
